verifications.claim: March Madness 2026 games are available on TV via CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The tournament is broadcast across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV'; R3: 'March Madness games air across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV'; R4: 'across four national television networks – TBS, CBS, TNT and truTV'; R9: 'March Madness continues across CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV'; R10: 'across four national television networks – tbs, CBS, TNT and truTV'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state that 2026 March Madness games are broadcast on these exact four TV networks.

verifications.claim: March Madness Live streams all games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'all 67 games available live... and NCAA March Madness Live'; R8: 'watch every game of the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Live'; R9: 'the March Madness Live app will have every game, period'
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly confirm March Madness Live (or NCAA March Madness Live) streams every game.

verifications.claim: Paramount+ provides access to all CBS-aired games.

verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm Paramount+ streams all CBS March Madness games.

verifications.claim: According to CBS Sports and Deseret News, all First Four and Rounds 1-2 games are covered across the four main channels.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4 (CBS/TNT): 'all 67 games available live... across four national television networks – TBS, CBS, TNT and truTV'; R9 (CBS Sports): 'March Madness continues across CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV with... second-round games'; R7 (Deseret): 'TV: TBS' (for one Round 1 game)
verifications.reasoning: CBS Sports sources support coverage across four channels for all games (including First Four/Rounds 1-2); Deseret mentions one game on TBS but not comprehensively; attribution is broader than specific support.
